sentences.text: The gold loan FAQ does not state any pre-payment charge for gold loans; it only says a gold loan is a loan granted against the security of gold ornaments pledged with the Bank and that gold loans are granted for a period of up to 12 months.
The bank’s retail loan policy instead says foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding shall be levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower.

The UCB directions say that, in cases other than the specific exceptions, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB, and that for term loans any levied pre-payment charge shall be based on the amount being prepaid.
I could not find a gold-loan-specific pre-payment charge in the FAQ itself, so the exact charge for gold loans is not stated there.

missing.searched: Gold Loan FAQ, bank policy, and UCB pre-payment charge directions
